used_quotes: The night is far spent. Wake up out of sleep.
The first few days we insisted that you shouldn't ask God. It shouldn't be transactional.
There is a dimension of glory you cannot step into until your mind opens.
In our kingdom, we move forward by waiting.
Light that destroys darkness. Light that shatters ignorance. Light that would damage every darkness in my life.
SEE YOURSELF BEING BUILT UP. BRICK UPON BRICK, LINE UPON LINE.
Souls are not just one by sharing flyers and speaking to them.
This sickness is not unto death but for the glory of the Lord.
There is a type of prayer you pray that it would have been better you didn't pray.
When there are contentions and threats, the prayer becomes God, let it be too notable to deny.
Where there is a Pharaoh, God's own redemption takes precedence.
Your body may be tired, but your spirit can receive strength as you pray.
Everything responds to the word of God.
